name: DES16E1dcx field (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field toward the Type Ia supernova DES16E1dcx, seen by Hubble.
label: des16e1dcx-hubble
story: Somewhere in this patch of sky, a faraway Type Ia supernova found by the Dark Energy Survey flared. Hubble followed it as part of a program using these explosions as standard candles to chart the history of cosmic expansion.

claims.text: DES16E1dcx is a Type Ia supernova from the Dark Energy Survey, at the observed position
DES16E1dcx was a target of HST program 14216 (RAISIN2), one of a sample of Type Ia supernovae discovered with the Dark Energy Survey
The program uses Type Ia supernovae as standard candles to build the cosmic expansion history
